item.title: Hime Koi ☆ Fechi Koi ~Ano Ko no Seiheki ni Ijou Ari!~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Swaneye+
  • 発売日: 2010-10-29
  • スコア: 6.09/10 (9 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ひめ恋☆ふぇち恋 ～あの娘の性癖に異常アリ!～
  • 英語名: Hime Koi ☆ Fechi Koi Ano Ko no Seiheki ni Ijou Ari!

あらすじ

Private Yutoku Gakuen is a co-educational school, but it is a special school where the living spaces for boys and girls are divided.

Because of this, there are constant requests from Rikuto, the photography club, to take pictures of girls.

I’m not enthusiastic, but I’m still taking pictures of girls today…

item.title: Maman Kyoushitsu ~Mirai no H na Obenkyou~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Swaneye+
  • 発売日: 2009-10-30
  • スコア: 6.75/10 (673 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ままん教室～未来のHなお勉強～
  • 英語名: Maman Kyoushitsu Mirai no H na Obenkyou

あらすじ

You’re tasked with teaching H lessons to pregnant women.

The protagonist, Kei Washinosu is searching for a job. Every time he goes out, he greets her, Honoka Mizushima, a woman working part-time at a confectionery store, who he has the hots for, however, she’s already married and and on top of that, pregnant.
